notes: Hand-maintained catalogue of recurring statement credits and use-it-or-lose-it perks on popular U.S. consumer cards. Values are the maximum per period. Issuers change these often; every card carries a benefits_url to verify against and a confidence rating. Business cards other than Amex Business Gold are not yet covered.
